expectations.text: States no: no Section 508 refresh rulemaking is under way as of November 2026
expectations.evidence: "As of November 2026 I'm not aware of any Access Board NPRM... the Federal Register record doesn't show one... treat the report as unsupported"

expectations.text: Explains the 2026 reports trace back to the 2015 proposed rule and are not supported by the Federal Register record
expectations.evidence: "The most likely source is the 2015 Access Board proposed rule (80 FR 10880)... reports in 2026 appear to have recycled it as if it were new"

expectations.text: States the operative baseline: the 2017 Revised 508 Standards (82 FR 5790, January 18, 2017) incorporating WCAG 2.0 Level AA
expectations.evidence: "published at 82 FR 5790 (January 18, 2017)" with "WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA, incorporated by reference"

expectations.text: Notes compliance has been required since January 18, 2018, with the legacy safe harbor for unaltered ICT
expectations.evidence: "Compliance has been required since January 18, 2018" and "Legacy ICT is covered by the safe harbor until it is altered or replaced"

expectations.text: Identifies the actual 2026 Access Board rulemakings as unrelated (universal changing stations ANPRM and FOIA regulations) or at minimum confirms no ICT rulemaking exists
expectations.evidence: Does not name the changing stations ANPRM or FOIA rules, but confirms no ICT rulemaking: "the Federal Register record doesn't show one"
